text:
already that huyes of mí, Lísida beautiful,

imita the costumbres of esta fountain,

that flee of the orilla eternamente,

and always the fecunda generosa.


flee of mí cortés and desdeñosa,

sígate of my eyes the corriente,

and, aunque of paso, tanto fire ardiente

merézcate a hierba and a rose.


Pues my sorrow ocasionas, pues you ríes

of the congojoso weeping that derramo

in sacrificio al claustro of rubíes,


perdona lo that soy por lo that amo,

and when desdeñosa you desvíes,

llévate allá the voice with that you llamo.

translation.title: A Lísida pidiéndole unas flowers that had in the hand
